arabic_blocks: [1119] حدثنا مسدد قال: حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد عن عبيد الله قال: أخبرنا نافع عن ابن عمر رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال صليت مع النبي ﷺ سجدتين قبل الظهر وسجدتين بعد الظهر وسجدتين بعد المغرب وسجدتين بعد العشاء وسجدتين بعد الجمعة فأما المغرب والعشاء ففي بيته وحدثتني أختي حفصة أن النبي ﷺ كان يصلي سجدتين خفيفتين بعد ما يطلع الفجر وكانت ساعة لا أدخل على النبي ﷺ فيها، وقال ابن أبي الزناد عن موسى بن عقبة عن نافع بعد العشاء في أهله تابعه كثير بن فرقد وأيوب عن نافع
english_blocks: Musaddad related to us. He said: Yahya ibn Sa‘id related to us, from ‘Ubaydullah. He said: Nafi‘ informed us, from Ibn ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, who said:

I prayed with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, two rak‘ahs before Dhuhr, two rak‘ahs after Dhuhr, two rak‘ahs after Maghrib, two rak‘ahs after ‘Isha’, and two rak‘ahs after Jumu‘ah. As for Maghrib and ‘Isha’, they were in his house. My sister Hafsah related to me that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to pray two brief rak‘ahs after dawn appeared. It was an hour when I did not enter upon the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.
And Ibn Abi al-Zinad said, from Musa ibn ‘Uqbah, from Nafi‘: “After ‘Isha’, with his family.” Kathir ibn Farqad and Ayyub corroborated it from Nafi‘.

english_blocks: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abdullah related to us. He said: Sufyan related to us, from ‘Amr, who said: I heard Abu al-Sha‘tha’, Jabir, say: I heard Ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, say:
I prayed with the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, eight together and seven together.

english_blocks: ‘Ali ibn al-Ja‘d related to us. Shu‘bah informed us, from Anas ibn Sirin, who said: I heard Anas ibn Malik al-Ansari say:

A man of the Ansar, who was heavily built, said to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, “I am unable to pray with you.” He prepared food for the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, invited him to his house, and sprinkled the edge of a mat with water for him. He prayed two rak‘ahs on it.

So-and-so, son of so-and-so, son of Jarud, said to Anas, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, “Did the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, pray Duha?” He said, “I did not see him pray it except on that day.”

arabic_blocks: [1126] حدثنا سليمان بن حرب قال: حدثنا حماد بن زيد عن أيوب عن نافع عن ابن عمر رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال حفظت من النبي ﷺ عشر ركعات ركعتين قبل الظهر وركعتين بعدها وركعتين بعد المغرب في بيته وركعتين بعد العشاء في بيته وركعتين قبل صلاة الصبح كانت ساعة لا يدخل على النبي ﷺ فيها حدثتني حفصة أنه كان إذا إذن المؤذن وطلع الفجر صلى ركعتين
english_blocks: Sulayman ibn Harb related to us. He said: Hammad ibn Zayd related to us, from Ayyub, from Nafi‘, from Ibn ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, who said:

I remembered ten rak‘ahs from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: two rak‘ahs before Dhuhr and two after it, two rak‘ahs after Maghrib in his house, two rak‘ahs after ‘Isha’ in his house, and two rak‘ahs before the dawn prayer. It was an hour when no one would enter upon the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.
Hafsah related to me that when the caller gave the call to prayer and dawn had appeared, he would pray two rak‘ahs.

arabic_blocks: [1129] حدثنا عبد الله بن يزيد قال: حدثنا سعيد بن أبي أيوب قال: حدثني يزيد بن أبي حبيب قال: سمعت مرثد بن عبد الله اليزني قال أتيت عقبة بن عامر الجهني فقلت: ألا أعجبك من أبي تميم يركع ركعتين قبل صلاة المغرب، فقال عقبة إنا كنا نفعله على عهد رسول الله ﷺ قلت: فما يمنعك الآن قال الشغل

I came to ‘Uqbah ibn ‘Amir al-Juhani and said, “Shall I not tell you something surprising about Abu Tamim? He prays two rak‘ahs before the Maghrib prayer.” ‘Uqbah said, “We used to do that in the time of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.” I said, “What prevents you now?” He said, “Being occupied.”

arabic_blocks: [1130] حدثني إسحاق حدثنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم حدثنا أبي عن ابن شهاب قال: أخبرني محمود بن الربيع الأنصارى أنه عقل رسول الله ﷺ وعقل مجة مجها في وجهه من بئر كانت في دارهم فزعم محمود أنه سمع عتبان بن مالك الأنصارى رضى الله تعالى عنه وكان ممن شهد بدرا مع رسول الله ﷺ يقول: كنت أصلي لقومي ببني سالم وكان يحول بيني وبينهم واد إذا جاءت الأمطار فيشق علي اجتيازه قبل مسجدهم فجئت رسول الله ﷺ فقلت له إني أنكرت بصري وإن الوادي الذي بيني وبين قومي يسيل إذا جاءت الأمطار فيشق علي اجتيازه فوددت أنك تأتي فتصلي من بيتي مكانا أتخذه مصلى، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: سأفعل فغدا علي رسول الله ﷺ وأبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه بعد ما اشتد النهار فاستأذن رسول الله ﷺ فأذنت له فلم يجلس حتى قال أين تحب أن أصلي من بيتك فأشرت له إلى المكان الذي أحب أن أصلي فيه فقام رسول الله ﷺ فكبر وصففنا وراءه فصلى ركعتين ثم سلم وسلمنا حين سلم فحبسته على خزير يصنع له فسمع أهل الدار رسول الله ﷺ في بيتي فثاب رجال منهم حتى كثر الرجال في البيت، فقال رجل منهم ما فعل مالك لا أراه، فقال رجل منهم ذاك منافق لا يحب الله ورسوله، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: لا تقل ذاك ألا تراه قال لا إله إلا الله يبتغي بذلك وجه الله، فقال الله ورسوله أعلم أما نحن فوالله لا نرى وده ولا حديثه إلا إلى المنافقين قال رسول الله ﷺ: فإن الله قد حرم على النار من قال لا إله إلا الله يبتغي بذلك وجه الله قال محمود فحدثتها قوما فيهم أبو أيوب صاحب رسول الله ﷺ في غزوته التي توفي فيها ويزيد بن معاوية عليهم بأرض الروم فأنكرها على أبو أيوب قال والله ما أظن رسول الله ﷺ قال: ما قلت: قط فكبر ذلك علي فجعلت لله علي إن سلمني حتى أقفل من غزوتي أن أسأل عنها عتبان بن مالك رضى الله تعالى عنه إن وجدته حيا في مسجد قومه فقفلت فأهللت بحجة أو بعمرة ثم سرت حتى قدمت المدينة فأتيت بني سالم فإذا عتبان شيخ أعمى يصلي لقومه فلما سلم من الصلاة سلمت عليه وأخبرته من أنا ثم سألته عن ذلك الحديث فحدثنيه كما حدثنيه أول مرة
english_blocks: Ishaq related to me. Ya‘qub ibn Ibrahim related to us. My father related to us, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Mahmud ibn al-Rabi‘ al-Ansari informed me:
He remembered the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and remembered a mouthful of water that the Messenger sprayed into his face from a well that was in their house.

Mahmud related that he heard ‘Itban ibn Malik al-Ansari, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who was among those who witnessed Badr with the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say: “I used to lead my people in prayer among Banu Salim. A valley lay between me and them; when the rains came, it was difficult for me to cross it toward their mosque. I came to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and said to him, ‘I have found my eyesight impaired, and the valley between me and my people flows when the rains come, making it difficult for me to cross it. I would like you to come and pray in a place in my house that I could take as a prayer place.’ The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, ‘I will do so.’”

“The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, came to me in the morning after the day had advanced. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, asked permission to enter, and I gave him permission. He did not sit until he said, ‘Where in your house would you like me to pray?’ I pointed out to him the place where I liked to pray. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stood, said the takbir, and we formed rows behind him. He prayed two rak‘ahs, then said the taslim, and we said the taslim when he did.”

“I kept him for khazir that was being prepared for him. The people of the neighbourhood heard that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was in my house, and men from among them gathered until there were many men in the house. One of them said, ‘What has happened to Malik? I do not see him.’ One of them said, ‘He is a hypocrite who does not love Allah and His Messenger.’”

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Do not say that. Do you not see that he has said, ‘There is no god except Allah,’ seeking by that the face of Allah?” He said, “Allah and His Messenger know best. As for us, by Allah, we see his affection and his conversation directed only toward the hypocrites.” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “For Allah has forbidden to the Fire whoever says, ‘There is no god except Allah,’ seeking by that the face of Allah.”

Mahmud said: I related it to some people among whom was Abu Ayyub, the companion of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, during his expedition in which he died, with Yazid ibn Mu‘awiyah over them in the land of the Romans. Abu Ayyub objected to it, saying to me, “By Allah, I do not think the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, ever said what you have said.” That weighed heavily on me, so I made a vow to Allah that, if He kept me safe until I returned from my expedition, I would ask ‘Itban ibn Malik, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, about it if I found him alive in the mosque of his people.

I returned and entered ihram for a Hajj or an ‘Umrah. Then I travelled until I reached Medina and came to Banu Salim. There was ‘Itban, an old blind man, leading his people in prayer. When he said the taslim from the prayer, I greeted him, told him who I was, and then asked him about that report. He related it to me as he had related it to me the first time.

Perform some of your prayer in your houses, and do not make them graves.
